description: Look up one person by exactly one identifier: `profile` (LinkedIn profile URL or username), `email`, `twitter`, `facebook` or `github`. Optional sections add data to the answer and to the cost of the call: `socialLink`, `phoneNumber`, `personalEmail`, `workEmail`, `careerInsight`, `developerProfile`, `activities`. Ask only for the sections you need: each one adds data, and most add to the cost. `personalEmail` and `workEmail` return only addresses validated as deliverable. To find someone's work email from a profile URL, pass `profile` and `workEmail: "include"`: if `contactInformation.emails.work` is missing, no work email was found here, and find_work_emails with the person's name and company domain may still find candidates. `maxAgeSeconds` is the oldest cached copy you accept (default 30 days, usually answered in seconds). A small value starts a live lookup, which is slower and costs more: it can take up to 5 minutes and run past the time limit of the MCP client. A call cut off before the answer arrives may still be charged. To get the copy that was saved in the meantime, call again without maxAgeSeconds; do not repeat a live lookup right away. The result has the v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support. Fields with no value (null, empty lists, empty objects, empty text) are left out of `data`; for an optional section, a missing field means it found nothing or was not asked for. An answer is never longer than 24,000 bytes: if the full answer is longer, `data` keeps every field and every list that fits, and each list it leaves out is named in `more` with its number of items, its approximate size, its number of pages and a `cursor` for get_more. A list that is in `data` is always complete. Reading a page with get_more is a new lookup and is charged.

activities.description: Include up to 100 of the most recent posts from the person page, newest first with undated posts last, returned in the `activities` section. Default: exclude.

careerInsight.description: Include the estimated salary, seniority, and inferred skills, returned in the `careerInsight` section. Default: exclude.

developerProfile.description: Include the GitHub developer profile data, returned in the `developerProfile` section. Default: exclude.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum acceptable age of cached data, in seconds. Default: 2592000.

personalEmail.description: Include personal emails, returned in the `contactInformation.emails.personal` section. Default: exclude.

phoneNumber.description: Include phone numbers, returned in the `contactInformation.phoneNumbers` section. Default: exclude.

profile.description: Profile username (the part after /in/) or profile URL.

socialLink.description: Include the social profile URLs, returned in the `contactInformation.socialLinks` section, along with the corresponding usernames in the `slug` section. Default: exclude.

workEmail.description: Include work emails, returned in the `contactInformation.emails.work` section. Default: exclude.
